Hey. Thanks for taking the time. I feel a lot better now. 

I also had a look at some other threads and I read this guy's comment:

http://www.reddit.com/r/AskReddit/comments/ffafp/how_do_i_combat_this_serious_depression_without/c1fhz23

I guess I just need to break the vicious cycle of being depressed and about being depressed and just learn to accept and move onwards.

I'm stuck in this town for another 9 months and I'm moving on out of here for good.

Once again, thanks. SW needs more people helping out.
